name: duct tape jacket
description: an ancient denim jacket held together by duct tape. the tape is silver on one sleeve, black on the other, and there's a patch on the back covering a hole. it's technically tied around your waist most of the time.

params.message: you shrug on the jacket. something crinkles — the duct tape on the left shoulder has peeled again.
duct tape on the sleeves, duct tape on the collar, duct tape holding the pocket on. it's more tape than jacket at this point. you love it.
